docs.summary: Auto-slicing tools that generate a fresh list of [`SpriteSliceData`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Importers.SpriteSliceData) rects from a texture. Grid parameters use top-left display space; results are [`SpriteRect`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.SpriteRect)s in bottom-left / UV space. Tools that skip empty cells (and the Automatic tool) need the texture's alpha, read via [`ReadAlpha`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Importers.SpriteSlicer~ReadAlpha) (shared with the importer's tight-mesh path).

docs.summary: Runs the tool selected in `data` and returns a fresh slice list.

Reads a texture's alpha channel into an 8-bit, bottom-left-origin grid (length `w*h`), or null if readback fails / the format is unsupported. Shared by the slicing tools and the importer's tight-mesh pass. Requires a GL context (returns null off the render thread).
